camel_example: aliyun ens AttachInstanceSDG --region cn-hangzhou --SDGId 'sdg-xxxx' --DiskType standard --LoadOpt '{"CacheSize":20,"BlockRwSplit":true,"BlockRwSplitSize":20,"Cache":true}' --DiskAccessProtocol iscsi --InstanceIds '["aic-1"]'
description_en: Attach an SDG to the corresponding AIC
description_zh: 将某个SDG attach到对应的AIC上
kebab_example: aliyun ens attach-instance-sdg --instance-ids aic-1 --sdg-id sdg-xxxx --disk-type standard --disk-access-protocol iscsi --load-opt CacheSize=20 BlockRwSplit=true BlockRwSplitSize=20 Cache=true --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachInstanceSDG

parameters.help_en:
The disk type of the generated shared disk:

standard (standard disk).

rbd (RBD disk).

If the shared disk type is not specified, a standard disk is generated by default.

RBD shared disks can be generated only when the parent disk type is RBD
parameters.help_zh:
生产的共享盘磁盘类型：

standard(标准云盘)。
rbd（rbd云盘）。


不指定共享盘磁盘类型时默认生成标准云盘。
仅母盘类型为rbd时支持生成rbd共享盘
parameters.name: disk_type

parameters.help_en:
The access protocol type for the disk:

iscsi: The default protocol for standard disks. Both RBD disks and standard disks support this protocol.

rbd: The default protocol for RBD disks. Only RBD disks support this mount protocol
parameters.help_zh:
云盘访问协议类型：

iscsi：标准云盘默认协议，rbd云盘和标准云盘都支持该协议。

rbd：rbd云盘默认协议，只有rbd云盘支持该挂载协议
parameters.name: disk_access_protocol

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable block device read/write splitting. The default value is false
fields.help_zh: 指定是否开启块设备读写分离，默认false
fields.name: block_rw_split

fields.help_en: Block device read/write splitting size in GiB. If the value is 0, the default size is used
fields.help_zh: 块设备读写分离大小，单位为GiB，值为0时使用默认大小
fields.name: block_rw_split_size

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable cache (requires block device read/write splitting to be enabled). The default value is false
fields.help_zh: 指定是否开启缓存(需要开启块设备读写分离方可使用)，默认为false
fields.name: cache

fields.help_en: Cache size in GiB. If the value is 0, the default size is used
fields.help_zh: 缓存大小，单位为GiB，值为0时使用默认大小
fields.name: cache_size

parameters.help_zh: 文件加载速率优化参数
parameters.name: load_opt
